changes: Fix SMS storage: messages are now read from and stored in both the modem and the SIM card, new messages are stored in the modem's memory by default and automatically move to the SIM card when the modem is full, and the message list shows messages in the correct order regardless of which store they came from. A message settings menu lets you choose a specific store instead.
Fix USSD on some Qualcomm modem revisions.
Open Wi-Fi networks work again: a client joining a network with no encryption now gets an address instead of being cut off right after it connects.
Hold the RESET button until the front panel flashes to restore factory settings.
New tool restores factory settings over TFTP, for a router that no longer boots.
